intro: Chad is a presidential republic led by Mahamat Déby.

chapters.title: How it works
text: Mahamat Déby took power after his father's death in 2021 and won a 2024 election that critics called unfair. In 2025 term limits were removed.

chapters.title: Foreign troops
text: French troops left Chad in early 2025.
